name: chevron-line-down
description: A rounded chevron pointing down toward a separate stop line.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner explicitly requested larger native None glyphs while retaining the existing smaller Square/Circle glyphs unchanged. Chevron Line None uniformly scales its original centerlines by73/32 about12,12. Its20px primary extent includes round caps at Regular1.75; the other opposing pair retains the natural aspect ratio. All directions are rigid rotations; head and stop line stay separate. None geometry is authored separately from frames, with no runtime style/frame scaling and no scaling of stroke width. Rebuild all Filled contours at the fixed source stroke expansion; never scale a previous Filled path. Square/Circle SVG and metadata files retain their previous exact artwork and dimensions. This supersedes the older requirement that None and framed glyphs have identical size. Native X/Y100/100 and rotation0 remain the new None baseline. Revised None glyph awaits owner review; existing frame review status is unchanged.

review.note: Larger native None glyph requested by owner; smaller Square/Circle variants are preserved unchanged. Awaiting owner visual review.
